cheesy scrambled eggs on toast

Yield: 2 servings

Ingredients
- 4 eggs
- 2 tbsp. butter
- 1/4 cup milk
- 1/2 cup shredded cheddar
- 4 slices bread
- salt and pepper
- 2 tbsp. chives

Preparation
1) crack the eggs in a bowl and whisk em with the milk
2) melt the butter in a pan on medium low
3) pour it into the pan, stirring slowly till just set, about 3 min
4) fold in the cheddar
5) pile onto the bread and sprinkle with chives, salt and pepper
